name: mirage
text: Yes, that is the right idea, and it's close to what the all-time number is meant to use now: Novig's own ledger for the Vigilant subaccount (every payout, refund and credit, less every stake, bid fill and fee), not this phone's bet records. For the DAILY view, winnings (stake returned included) minus cost, per game day, is exactly right for settled bets. Two catches: (1) an open bet or a resting bid is money at stake, not a loss, so it must stay out until it settles (otherwise the wallet looks like it dropped, as it did this afternoon); (2) a day's figure is only final once that day's games are graded, so Today reads $0.00 until results arrive. One real bug is still open (TR3): two wallet figures disagree by about $72 (equity $109 vs cash+positions $182), which is why the number swung. I'm making the tracker use the ledger as the single source, per game day, and will tell you when it ships.
